faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella?
faq.a: The maximum group size depends on the boat. Our fleet accommodates from 5 to 12 passengers. For example, the Dubhe holds 5, while the Ferretti 94 holds up to 12. Always check the specific vessel's capacity before booking.

faq.q: Can we exceed the passenger limit if we have children?
faq.a: No, the passenger limit includes everyone on board, regardless of age. Infants, children, and adults all count toward the maximum. This is a strict safety regulation enforced by Spanish law.

faq.q: What happens if we show up with more people than the boat allows?
faq.a: The skipper will not allow boarding if the group exceeds the vessel's certified capacity. You would need to split into multiple boats or reduce your group size. We recommend booking the correct-sized boat in advance.

faq.q: Are there boats that can accommodate 12 passengers?
faq.a: Yes, several boats in our fleet hold 12 passengers, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, and Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús.

faq.q: What is the smallest boat available for a group?
faq.a: The smallest boat in our fleet is the Mariah SX21 (6.4m), which holds up to 5 passengers. It's ideal for small groups or couples wanting a private experience.

faq.q: Do group size limits change in 2040?
faq.a: No, group size limits are based on the boat's certification and do not change by year. The limits for 2040 will be the same as today unless maritime regulations are updated. Always confirm with us at booking.

faq.q: Can we book multiple boats for a large group?
faq.a: Yes, you can charter multiple boats from our fleet to accommodate larger groups. For example, two Mangusta 80s can carry up to 24 passengers collectively. Contact us via WhatsApp for coordination.

faq.q: Is there a minimum group size for a boat rental?
faq.a: No minimum group size exists. You can charter any boat for as few as one person. However, the price is per boat, not per person, so smaller groups may prefer smaller vessels for better value.

data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the water in Marbella? Knowing the boat rental group size limits Marbella 2040 is essential to avoid disappointment. Each vessel in our fleet has a certified maximum passenger capacity, ranging from 5 to 12 people. These limits are set by Spanish maritime law and cannot be exceeded, regardless of age or size of guests. Whether you're organising a birthday party, corporate event, or family reunion, understanding these numbers ensures a smooth booking process. Below, we break down the capacity of every boat we offer from Puerto Banús.

Why Group Size Limits Matter

Group size limits are not arbitrary. They are based on the boat's safety certification, which considers life raft capacity, stability, and emergency evacuation procedures. Exceeding the limit invalidates insurance and puts everyone at risk. All our charters include a licensed skipper who enforces these rules. For a stress-free day on the Mediterranean, always book a vessel that matches your headcount.

Fleet Capacity Overview

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús and covers a wide range of sizes. Here is the maximum passenger capacity for each boat:

  • Dubhe (8m): 5 pax
  • Mariah SX21 (6.4m): 5 pax
  • Speedboat (7m): 6 pax
  • Red Tide (11m): 6 pax
  • Bandido (11.5m): 8 pax
  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m): 9 pax
  • Fairline Targa 12m (12m): 10 pax
  • Lagoon 380 (11.6m): 10 pax
  • Pershing 46 (14m): 10 pax
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m): 11 pax
  • Mangusta 80 (24m): 12 pax
  • Mangusta 80 (Grey) (24m): 12 pax
  • Azimut 58 Flybridge (17.6m): 12 pax
  • Canados 86 (26m): 12 pax
  • Ferretti 94 (29m): 12 pax
  • K80 (24m): 12 pax
  • Maiora 26m (26m): 12 pax

How to Choose the Right Boat for Your Group

For groups of up to 5, the Dubhe or Mariah SX21 are cost-effective choices. Groups of 6 to 8 can opt for the Bandido or Red Tide. For 9 to 11 passengers, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 work well. If you have a full party of 12, choose from the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, or any of the larger yachts. All depart from Puerto Banús, making it easy to start your day on the Costa del Sol.

Booking for Larger Groups

If your group exceeds 12 people, you can charter multiple boats. For instance, two Mangusta 80s can carry up to 24 passengers. Contact us via WhatsApp to coordinate simultaneous departures and itineraries. This is a popular option for weddings, corporate retreats, and large family gatherings.

Inclusions Across All Charters

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). No hidden fees. The skipper handles navigation so you can relax and enjoy the coast from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Estepona.

Legal Considerations for 2040

Maritime regulations in Spain are stable, and group size limits for 2040 will remain based on vessel certification. No changes are anticipated, but we always recommend confirming capacities at the time of booking. For the most accurate information, visit our main page or contact us directly.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella?

The maximum group size depends on the boat. Our fleet accommodates from 5 to 12 passengers. For example, the Dubhe holds 5, while the Ferretti 94 holds up to 12. Always check the specific vessel's capacity before booking.

Can we exceed the passenger limit if we have children?

No, the passenger limit includes everyone on board, regardless of age. Infants, children, and adults all count toward the maximum. This is a strict safety regulation enforced by Spanish law.

What happens if we show up with more people than the boat allows?

The skipper will not allow boarding if the group exceeds the vessel's certified capacity. You would need to split into multiple boats or reduce your group size. We recommend booking the correct-sized boat in advance.

Are there boats that can accommodate 12 passengers?

Yes, several boats in our fleet hold 12 passengers, including the Mangusta 80, Azimut 58 Flybridge, Canados 86, Ferretti 94, K80, and Maiora 26m. All depart from Puerto Banús.

What is the smallest boat available for a group?

The smallest boat in our fleet is the Mariah SX21 (6.4m), which holds up to 5 passengers. It's ideal for small groups or couples wanting a private experience.

Do group size limits change in 2040?

No, group size limits are based on the boat's certification and do not change by year. The limits for 2040 will be the same as today unless maritime regulations are updated. Always confirm with us at booking.

Can we book multiple boats for a large group?

Yes, you can charter multiple boats from our fleet to accommodate larger groups. For example, two Mangusta 80s can carry up to 24 passengers collectively. Contact us via WhatsApp for coordination.

Is there a minimum group size for a boat rental?

No minimum group size exists. You can charter any boat for as few as one person. However, the price is per boat, not per person, so smaller groups may prefer smaller vessels for better value.
